t.E967.agn: In the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E967.body: When consumed in excess, it may cause gas and diarrhoea in the gut.
t.E967.eff.0.t: May cause gas, bloating and diarrhoea (laxative effect); in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols
t.E967.eff.1.a: Gas from 45 g a day; transient diarrhoea at 65–80 g a day
t.E967.eff.1.t: Gas, occasional abdominal pain and transient diarrhoea have been reported
t.E967.eval: Polyol (sugar alcohol): in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols; avoided in sensitive gut (FODMAP) diets. It is highly toxic to dogs; it should not be given to pets.
t.E967.prod: Obtained from sugar or starch by hydrogenation (a chemical process).
t.E967.regx.0: The warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E967.summary: A polyol obtained from birch wood or corn cobs. Common in sugar-free chewing gum and tooth-friendly confectionery.
t.E967.what: A sugar alcohol (polyol): it provides sweetness and bulk in sugar-free products and retains moisture.
t.flag.pet_risk.0: One of the substances known to be toxic to dogs and cats.
